description:
Search and explore real estate across India with Square Yards.
                                                                                                    
  Square Yards gives you conversational access to one of India's largest property databases. Search
  new construction projects, rental apartments, and resale properties across major cities, all     
  through natural conversation.                                                                     
                                                                                                    
  Find new projects: Browse new-construction developments with filters for city, budget, unit type,
  developer, and project status. Dive into any project to see pricing, floor plans, amenities, and
  unit configurations.                                                                              
                  
  Search rentals: Explore rental listings filtered by city, rent range, BHK type, furnishing       
  status, and amenities. Get full details on any listing including images and pricing.
                                                                                                    
  Browse resale properties: Discover resale and second-hand listings with filters for city, price  
  range, unit type, and amenities. View complete property details for any listing that catches your
  eye.                                                                                              
                  
  Results appear as interactive property cards with images, pricing, and direct links to      
  Square Yards. Whether you're buying your first home, searching for a rental, or exploring
  investment opportunities, Square Yards helps you make informed property decisions through          
  conversation.

defaultPrompt: Show me new projects in Pune under 2 crore
Show me more information about the project Purva Estrella in Mumbai
